title: fix(service-analytics): a consolidated measure over the home field works unchanged (proof), and the record-currency refusal names the home field (multi-currency M3-1)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-bill"} -->
_Requested by **Bill** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg?thread=cmsg_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wgNdDwFvZLCevqYiyR8iafDv)_

epic:#8345#1 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CZWjnSeed8H4dMjt9d

Fixes #27195
Ruling-ref: 6465431966

Clause-②: yes (widening) — `AnalyticsServiceConfig.sourceFieldMeta` (an exported config type) may answer one more optional key, `homeAmountField`, which `AnalyticsServicePlugin` relays; nothing an author writes changes
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么：** 新增证明测试：三种记录币种（USD/EUR/CNY）的行经写入投影存入影子列后，数据集度量 `sum` 影子列在内存预览、SQLite、Postgres 上都直接得出本位币合计，代码路径零改动；未分组汇总原始金额的拒绝文案现在同时给出两个药方：指向影子列（宿主透传时点名），或按币种码分组。
- **为什么改：** 仪表盘是客户看合并数的地方；原文案只教「按币种分组」，没告诉作者要一个合计该指向影子列。
- **风险与回滚：** 小。错误码、状态、member/field/object 信封不变，只改文案；`sourceFieldMeta` 多一个可选键（Clause-② widening），宿主不答时文案不点名字段。回滚即撤 PR。
- **先看：** `packages/services/service-analytics/src/cube-record-currency-door.ts` 的文案，再看 `home-amount-consolidated-measure.test.ts`。
- **两分钟验证：** `OS_TEST_POSTGRES_URL=… npx vitest run src/__tests__/home-amount-consolidated-measure.test.ts`（36 条）；在 main 上跑同一文件，证明部分全绿、文案断言红。
- **需要您做的：** 无。

## What changes

**The proof (no product code).** `src/__tests__/home-amount-consolidated-measure.test.ts` writes four invoices in three record currencies (USD, EUR and the home CNY) through the engine, whose write-time projection (ADR-0144 D5, `home-amount-projection.ts`) stores each amount converted into the home currency in the declared `homeAmount.field`. A dataset measure `sum` over that home field answers the home-currency total through `queryDataset` (dataset compile + query), on:

- SQLite and PostgreSQL, each on both strategies (`NativeSQLStrategy`; `ObjectQLStrategy`, narrowed to the engine aggregate);
- the draft-preview in-memory evaluator, over the very rows the projection stored (read back from the store). This "memory" cell is that evaluator, not `driver-memory`.

Pinned per cell: the projection fixture (home amounts and rates as stored); the ungrouped KPI (2010 CNY); per-currency subtotals grouped by the code field and a `totals` grand total equal to the KPI; the column labelled with the home currency and no per-row `currencyField` (the home field is `dynamic`); the inferred cube's `amount_home_sum`; a relationship path (a line cube joined to the invoice: `invoice.amount` refused naming `invoice.amount_home` and `invoice.currency_code`, `invoice.amount_home` served on the native strategy); `INVALID_FIELD` and status 400 on every refusal path (dataset, inferred cube, joined cube, draft preview). Control: the raw amount grouped by code is served per currency and adds to a different number (270). On `main` the proof assertions already pass, so the consolidated path is the unchanged code path.

**The door message (text only).** `assertRecordCurrencyAggregatesGrouped` (#27187, PR #27338) refused an ungrouped `sum` / `avg` / `min` / `max` over a record-mode amount with one prescription: group by the code field. It now names both:

- for one total in the home currency, point the measure at the amount's home field, by name (`homeAmount.field`) when the host relays it, or else as "the field its `currencyConfig.homeAmount.field` names", with the declaration to add if it has none (true whether or not the object declares one);
- for one row per currency, add the dimension over the code field.

Code `INVALID_FIELD`, status 400, `member` / `param` / `cube` / `field` / `object` are unchanged; no new refusal code. The home field reaches the door through `sourceFieldMeta`, which now answers `homeAmountField` beside `currencyField` (record mode only), relayed by `AnalyticsServicePlugin` from `currencyConfig.homeAmount.field`.

**Not in this diff.** The engine's own `aggregate()` door (`packages/objectql/src/record-currency-aggregate-door.ts`) already names a stored home-currency amount field generically; it is outside this card's file surface. ⛔ No `ui/**` / `plugin-dashboard` change (ui lane off). #27193 untouched.

## Why

ADR-0144 D6: a consolidated total aggregates the stored home field. The proof shows that needs nothing new; the message makes the refusal prescribe it.

## Verification

- `home-amount-consolidated-measure.test.ts`: 36/36 at the current head (30/30 at `e430075a`) with `OS_TEST_POSTGRES_URL` set (PostgreSQL 16, local). Ablation at `e430075a`: the same file on `main`'s three source files: 14 failed, every one a message assertion; every proof assertion passed.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/service-analytics typecheck`: exit 0. `eslint` on the changed files: exit 0.
- Package suite with `OS_TEST_POSTGRES_URL` (at `e430075a`): 5267 passed, 1 failed: `read-scope-temporal-coercion.test.ts` "the server is not on UTC (the premise of the PostgreSQL cells)", a premise check on the local server's zone (local PostgreSQL runs on `Etc/UTC`; CI provisions a skewed zone). Not touched by this diff.
- `dispatch-gates --commands` (at `e430075a`): 62 commands, exit codes captured before any pipe: 61 exit 0; `pnpm check:dual-build-cjs-loads` exit 3, NOT MEASURED (it reads every package's `dist/`, and this worktree built only this package's closure), left to CI. `check-plugin-teardown-shape --self-test` first exited 3 on the shallow clone and passed (exit 0) after fetching its pinned fixture commit.

One changeset, `@objectstack/service-analytics` patch.
